evidence.quote: Fasting blood samples were drawn between 8-11am from healthy volunteers on IRB approved protocol (09-H-0239), and processed within 30 minutes.
Total and influenza-specific IgG/A frequencies of antibody-secreting cells were measured by ELISpot assays modified for frozen samples ( Ho et al., 2011 ).
Microarray data were processed using APT (Affymetrix).
